mostWorthwhile.text: Ren's installed stop test was most worthwhile: disconnecting the network and actually stopping the pump showed the difference between a bench-tested part and a working safeguard.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated failed installation attempts made the required sequence feel opaque, especially when the tested stop could not yet connect to the cabinet.

surprise.text: The contact-test rig could not initially be used on the stop button; the button first needed a service lead. Once fitted, the same rig tested it successfully.

arbitrary.text: The need to give the cabinet a local reporting address before fitting the independent stop felt like an unexplained ordering constraint.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical safety checks and the final working tap made the infrastructure story tangible, though I would hope for clearer preparation dependencies.
